audience: Engineers onboarding to the HTR document-processing platform

mode_descriptions.dev: Docker Compose on a workstation; single Ray Serve replica per stage; Argo Workflows in a kind cluster; models pulled once from HF Hub then cached on disk
mode_descriptions.prod: On-prem Kubernetes; Ray autoscaling worker pool; Ray Serve scaled per stage (segmentation/transcription/post-processing); NATS JetStream + Postgres HA; OTel shipping traces to the platform collector

flows.name: HTR Ingest (POST /documents)
flows.purpose: Main pipeline. Upload a scanned document → Argo DAG fans out per page → Ray Serve runs segmentation, transcription, post-processing → artifacts + transcript stored.
step_outline: gateway → artifacts: put raw scan, mint document_id
gateway → argo     : submit htr-ingest Workflow {document_id, pages}
argo → rayserve    : per-page step calls Serve deployment graph
stages → artifacts : write PAGE-XML / ALTO + line crops
rayserve → nats    : publish htr.page.done {document_id, page, status}
argo → state       : upsert document + page status (Postgres), cache in Redis

flows.name: Status Poll (GET /documents/{id})
flows.purpose: Frontend polls progress while the DAG runs. Reads aggregated page status from state, no recompute.
step_outline: gateway → state: read aggregated page status (Redis hit, Postgres miss)
gateway → nats : subscribe htr.page.* for live updates (optional SSE)

flows.name: Reprocess (POST /documents/{id}/reprocess)
flows.purpose: Re-run a document against a newer model version. Re-submits the DAG; reuses the stored raw scan, overwrites artifacts.
step_outline: gateway → hfhub  : ensure model_rev pulled / warm on Ray Serve
gateway → argo   : re-submit htr-ingest {document_id, model_rev, force}
argo → rayserve  : re-run stages on cached raw scan
argo → state     : bump document version, invalidate Redis

flows.name: Model Warm-up (prod startup)
flows.purpose: On Ray Serve start, each HTR stage pulls its model from HF Hub once and caches it. Prod-only — dev uses an already-cached on-disk model.

lessons: Argo Workflows is the DAG controller (orch); the per-page work is delegated to Ray Serve (compute), and the three HTR stages are modeled as a single embed node — segmentation → transcription → post-processing — to keep the role count at 6.
NATS JetStream carries htr.page.* events so the gateway can stream progress without polling the database on every request. Status poll reads Redis first, Postgres on miss.
Redis + Postgres share the single vector role (violet) and are distinguished by label, not a 7th color — same trick for the artifact store and HF Hub.
The OTel collector and the model warm-up flow are prod-only: dev caches models on disk and skips the central collector, so node.modes and only_mode keep dev from showing a broken state.
dev vs prod is a true mode toggle — same topology, only replicas/ports/HA swap. It does NOT change which services exist (except the prod-only OTel side-concern), so one diagram covers both.
